_comment: Editorial half of the landing page's contributor strip. The list itself
is not here — it comes from GitHub at publish time (see
tools/gen-contributors.mjs). This file only supplies the parts an API
cannot know: the display name and the one-line role under it.
A contributor with no entry below still appears; their role line falls
back to their commit count. Add them here to give it a name.
The order of `people` is the order of the strip. Anyone not listed is
appended after them, most commits first, up to `limit` faces total.
